answer_1.quote: Large Visual Language Models (LVLMs) combine vision and language processing, taking text and image inputs to generate free-form text output for multimodal tasks.
answer_1.outputs: free-form text output for multimodal tasks

answer_2.quote: (2) Toxicity Rate is the proportion of outputs with a toxicity score exceeding 0.5 for each toxic attribute assessed by Perspective API and Detoxify classifier. We aggregate the toxicity scores across all attributes to assess the toxicity of a response in optimization, denoted as T(x adv , y adv ).
